# `arrays_zip`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a merged array of structs in which the N-th struct contains all
N-th values of input arrays.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
arrays_zip(a1, a2, ...)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- arrays_zip, example 1
> SELECT arrays_zip(array(1, 2, 3), array(2, 3, 4));
[{"0":1,"1":2},{"0":2,"1":3},{"0":3,"1":4}]
```

```sql
-- arrays_zip, example 2
> SELECT arrays_zip(array(1, 2), array(2, 3), array(3, 4));
[{"0":1,"1":2,"2":3},{"0":2,"1":3,"2":4}]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
